analysis:
Examined all supplied units, including file metadata, the test-guide patch and surrounding BASE text, and build-guide HEAD lines 490–678. No concrete security regression is established by this documentation-only evidence. docs/developer/test.md HEAD lines 142–146 remove PR cache writes and restrict build-cache publication to dev/master pushes; this narrows the documented untrusted-cache publication surface. HEAD lines 148–153 make the native MiMo audio gate conditional on component inputs, while retaining full execution on master pushes. Correct dependency classification is now important to native media regression coverage (TB-007, A-001, T-050), but an omitted dependency is not demonstrated here. The unchanged build-guide excerpt retains source/resource matching, qualification limitations, lifecycle barriers and cache-budget requirements; it does not establish a new T-041 cache behavior.
Integration must reconcile these claims with the changed CI workflows, provider-ci-build cache keys/save conditions, shard gate/summary logic and scripts/ci-component-paths.py MIMO_AUDIO dependency closure. In particular, verify that skipped audio gates cannot be reported as executed and that security-relevant media changes select the gate. The build.md changes at HEAD 170–174, 273–277 and 299–382 are outside the supplied numbered excerpt; the bounded orientation patch mentions preinstalled CMake validation, push-run routing and caching, but is insufficient to validate their controls. These are coverage limits requiring integration review, not findings. No supplied change alters serving authorization, attestation, hop encryption, billing or production prefix-cache isolation.
